parrafo_1.es: Sun City Cleaning es un negocio local de limpieza residencial que atiende St. Petersburg, Largo, Clearwater, Seminole, Pinellas Park y Tampa. Hacemos limpieza estandar, profunda, de mudanza, Airbnb y post construccion.
parrafo_1.en: Sun City Cleaning is a local residential cleaning business serving St. Petersburg, Largo, Clearwater, Seminole, Pinellas Park and Tampa. We handle standard, deep, move-in/move-out, Airbnb and post construction cleaning.

parrafo_2.es: Nuestros clientes repiten lo mismo: somos confiables, minuciosos y faciles de contactar. Varios nos confian la llave de su casa o de su Airbnb sin dudarlo.
parrafo_2.en: Our customers say the same thing again and again: we are reliable, thorough and easy to communicate with. Several trust us with the key to their home or their Airbnb without a second thought.

texto.es: Nos cuentas el tamano de tu casa y el tipo de limpieza que necesitas, y te damos un estimado.
texto.en: Tell us the size of your home and the type of cleaning you need, and we give you an estimate.

texto.es: Cubrimos St. Petersburg y el area de Tampa Bay, en el horario que te acomode.
texto.en: We cover St. Petersburg and the Tampa Bay area, at a time that works for you.

texto.es: De la cocina al baño, con atencion a los detalles y productos de calidad.
texto.en: From kitchen to bathroom, with attention to detail and quality products.

texto.es: Recorremos la casa contigo si estas presente, para que quede como lo esperabas.
texto.en: We walk the home with you if you are present, so it comes out the way you expected.

nota.es: Cada trabajo se cotiza segun el tamano de la casa y el tipo de limpieza. Sin sorpresas al llegar.
nota.en: Every job is quoted based on the size of the home and the type of cleaning. No surprises on arrival.

pie.es: Precio exacto confirmado antes de ir, segun el trabajo.
pie.en: Exact pricing confirmed before we come out, based on the job.

texto.es: Limpieza regular de cocina, baños y areas comunes, semanal o quincenal.
texto.en: Regular cleaning of kitchen, bathrooms and common areas, weekly or biweekly.

texto.es: Detalle en zocalos, electrodomesticos y rincones que la limpieza regular no alcanza.
texto.en: Detail work on baseboards, appliances and corners regular cleaning does not reach.

texto.es: Casa lista para entregar o recien construida, limpia de principio a fin.
texto.en: A home ready to hand over or freshly built, cleaned from top to bottom.

texto.es: Limpieza entre huespedes, lista a tiempo para tu proxima reserva.
texto.en: Turnover cleaning between guests, ready in time for your next booking.
